product.name: LandRocker Telegram Miner App
product.description: A Telegram-based application that allows users to command rovers and mine planets for crypto rewards directly within the Telegram platform.

product.name: LandRocker Command Center
product.description: A mission hub where players complete commands to mine planets, earn LRT tokens, and exchange gathered materials for cryptocurrencies.

product.name: LandRocker NFT Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace for trading, purchasing, and managing NFTs related to the LandRocker game, including assets on Polygon and Immutable zkEVM blockchains.

product.name: Immutable Galaxy NFT Collection
product.description: An NFT collection launched on the Immutable blockchain featuring exclusive in-game assets like suits and planets that provide gameplay advantages and passive income opportunities.

identifier.value: LandRocker Play Modes: Lite and Pro

product.name: LandRocker Play Modes: Lite and Pro
product.description: Two gameplay modes: Lite, a browser-based mining game with simple controls; and Pro, a 3D dynamic game requiring rovers and fuel for advanced play-to-earn experiences.

product.name: LandRocker Ambassador Program
product.description: A program enabling influencers to invite followers via unique treasure maps, earning rewards convertible to LRT tokens based on user engagement and mining activity.
